_comment: Checked-in PTDL_v2 egg for the existing Foreverworld Wildworks release. Import manually in the Panel; do not add secrets to this file.
name: Wildworks NeoForge (game-slot interlocked)
author: stevedwray@protonmail.com
description: Runs the pre-built Wildworks NeoForge 1.21.1 server through its release-native run.sh. Requires the shared /game-slot read-only mount documented in minecraft-migration.md.
startup: exec 9</game-slot/active.lock; if ! flock -n -E 75 9; then echo 'GAME SLOT BUSY: another game server is already running on this node.'; exit 75; fi; test -x ./run.sh || { echo 'Wildworks run.sh is missing or not executable; migration is incomplete.'; exit 66; }; exec ./run.sh nogui

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cat > /mnt/server/MIGRATION_REQUIRED.txt <<'EOF'
This server intentionally has no downloadable base installation.
Copy the reviewed Foreverworld manifest into this volume before first start.
See docs/gaming-stack-lab/minecraft-migration.md in the infrastructure repository.
EOF
printf 'eula=false\n' > /mnt/server/eula.txt
echo 'Wildworks staging volume created; complete the documented migration before starting.'
